references.text: Isaiah refers to the keys of the house of David, symbolizing authority and power, which is similar to what Jesus says about the keys to the kingdom of heaven.
The book of Psalms speaks of binding and loosing, which can be seen as a parallel to the authority given in Matthew.
Jesus again speaks of binding and loosing, referring to the authority he has given to his disciples.
Peter uses the keys to the kingdom of heaven on Pentecost, pointing to the fulfillment of what Jesus said in Matthew.
